messages:
maya: quick check — overnight triage snapshot. Queue: 42 open, 5 P1s, 9 P2s. Noticed auth spike from EU region between 01:10-01:25 UTC. Any owners? :eyes:

alex: I'm on the P1 (#5821) — seeing 500s from token-service (trace id: 8b3f). Repro locally with curl, logs show kv fetch timeout.

triage-bot: ticket #5821 assigned to alex, priority=P1, SLA window = 4h.

kevin: Can we run the EU auth macro? Current macro clears sessions but doesn't clear redis-kv. I can patch macro in a sec.

alex: That would help — I see retries piling up. ETA 15m to isolate cause. Adding debug flag to token-service.

lisa: Heads-up: two customers (acme & betaapp) reported embed failures; might be related to rate-limiting fallback. Not P1 for now.

jon: Quick FYI — I'm free to do code review for alex's PR once he pushes. Ping me @jon when ready.

alex: PR pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/421. Tests failing on integration; looking into flakiness. @jon please review if green.

maya: Thanks. Macro change approved by ops: please include redis-kv flush step. Kevin, can you post the snippet in this thread?

kevin: Snippet:
```
# eu-auth-reset macro
- service: token-service
- action: clear_sessions
- action: flush_redis namespace=eu-tokens confirm=true
- wait: 10s
- action: restart_service token-service eu
```

triage-bot: macro 'eu-auth-reset' updated by kevin.

alex: After flushing redis, error rate dropped ~80%. Still seeing occasional timeouts; rolling a canary with reduced batch size.

lisa: I'll craft a customer-facing macro note to explain the brief outage window. Draft here: "We briefly rotated token cache for EU auth to remediate a transient timeout affecting token issuance. No credentials were exposed."

maya: Great. Last ask — anyone take morning shift handoff? I'm off at 09:00 PDT. If not, I'll drop a summary in #support-handoff.

jon: I can cover 09-12 PDT. Will monitor P1s and watch token-service dashboard.

maya: Perfect — thanks team. :heart:
